notes.title: Big Game Update!
notes.content:
We've added new languages – now even more people can enjoy the game in their native language! It's now available in Traditional Chinese and Korean!

As a bonus, we've also made some minor fixes to the project.

notes.title: Controller Support and New Languages
notes.content:
Big Update! We've added controller support and new localizations, including: 
- French
- Italian
- German 
- Spanish
- Japanese
- Polish
- Portuguese - Brazil
- Simplified Chinese

We have also made the following improvements:
- Improved QTE UI
- Improved Gallery UI

Thank you for playing EmyLiveShow: How To Write A Bestseller ❤️
